confirmed_task: In psf/requests, filter to open non-draft pull requests and sort by most recently updated. Inspect the first three results. For each, report number, title, author, last-updated date, labels, changed-file count, additions, deletions, and whether any test file is included in Files changed. Rank the three by changed-file count. Stopping condition: stop after all three pull requests and their file-change summaries have been verified. Constraints: do not sign in; do not review, comment, react, merge, close, or modify pull requests; count only information GitHub displays.

items.criterion: Apply GitHub PR filters (open, non-draft) and sort by most recently updated
items.description: Agent uses the psf/requests Pull Requests page to reach a view that is as close as GitHub allows to: open PRs, excluding drafts, sorted by most recently updated. Full credit if the agent correctly applies UI controls or GitHub search qualifiers (e.g., is:pr is:open sort:updated-desc -is:draft) and clearly indicates the resulting ordering. Also full credit if GitHub UI/permissions/feature limitations prevent explicitly excluding drafts or sorting, as long as the agent explains the limitation and uses the closest achievable equivalent based only on what GitHub displays (e.g., open PR list sorted by updated, and manually skipping draft PRs visible in the list). Partial credit if the agent reaches open PRs but sorting/non-draft handling is unclear. No credit if the agent inspects PRs from a different repo or clearly includes closed/merged PRs without noting/correcting.

items.criterion: Inspect the first three results after filtering/sorting
items.description: Agent inspects (opens/views) the first three PRs in the resulting list (post-filter + sort / closest achievable equivalent). Full credit if the three inspected PRs are exactly the first three eligible items shown (skipping drafts only if drafts cannot be excluded and the agent states it is skipping them). Also full credit if a transient external blocker (rate limit, GitHub error, content failing to load) prevents opening one or more PRs and the agent clearly reports the blocker and reports only what is verifiable from list view/available tabs. Partial credit if the agent inspects three PRs but does not establish they are the first three in the sorted/filtered list. No credit if fewer than three are inspected without an external blocker explanation.

For the first inspected PR, report PR number, title, author, last-updated time/date (absolute date or GitHub-relative timestamp as displayed), labels (or explicitly state none/not visible), changed-file count, additions, deletions, and whether any test file appears in 'Files changed' based on visible filenames/paths. Full credit if all fields are correctly taken from what GitHub displays on the PR page and/or Files changed tab. If GitHub fails to load Files changed stats/file list due to external issues, full credit is still possible if the agent states what is not accessible and does not guess. Partial credit if 1–2 fields are missing/unclear but the rest are correct and grounded in visible UI.

For the second inspected PR, report PR number, title, author, last-updated time/date (absolute date or GitHub-relative timestamp as displayed), labels (or explicitly state none/not visible), changed-file count, additions, deletions, and whether any test file appears in 'Files changed' based on visible filenames/paths. Full credit if all fields are correctly taken from what GitHub displays. If GitHub fails to load some stats/file list due to external issues, full credit is still possible if the agent states what is not accessible and does not guess. Partial credit if 1–2 fields are missing/unclear but the rest are correct.

For the third inspected PR, report PR number, title, author, last-updated time/date (absolute date or GitHub-relative timestamp as displayed), labels (or explicitly state none/not visible), changed-file count, additions, deletions, and whether any test file appears in 'Files changed' based on visible filenames/paths. Full credit if all fields are correctly taken from what GitHub displays. If GitHub fails to load some stats/file list due to external issues, full credit is still possible if the agent states what is not accessible and does not guess. Partial credit if 1–2 fields are missing/unclear but the rest are correct.

items.criterion: Verify presence of test files in 'Files changed' for each PR
items.description: Agent’s Yes/No determination for each PR about test-file presence is clearly grounded in the 'Files changed' list (e.g., mentions observed paths like tests/, test_*.py, *_test.py) or explicitly states if the file list could not be accessed. Full credit if the agent demonstrates consistent, filename-based verification (or correctly reports inability to verify due to external loading/blocking). Partial credit if verification is provided but the grounding/evidence is unclear for 1–2 PRs. No credit if the agent appears to guess test-file presence without referencing visible filenames/paths.

items.criterion: Rank the three PRs by changed-file count
items.description: Agent ranks the three inspected PRs by changed-file count as displayed by GitHub (notes ties if applicable). Full credit if correct. If one or more PRs’ changed-file counts are not accessible due to external issues, full credit if the agent explains this and ranks only among the PRs with visible counts (or states ranking cannot be completed). Partial credit if ranking is attempted but contains a single ordering mistake.

items.criterion: Respect constraints: no sign-in and no PR modifications
items.description: Agent does not sign in and does not review, comment, react, merge, close, or otherwise modify any PRs; uses only information GitHub displays. Full credit if no prohibited actions are taken and the report sticks to visible GitHub UI data. Partial credit if the agent initiates but does not complete a modifying action and explicitly stops/backs out. No credit if any prohibited modification action is performed or if the agent claims data not shown by GitHub.
